Ingrid Adeyemi
ingrid.adeyemi@example.com | Denver, CO
Ingrid Adeyemi has 8 years of experience in backend and distributed systems.
Most recently, Senior Backend Engineer at Crestline Platform (2022-2026), where
they led migration of core services at Crestline Platform onto Kafka, improving
uptime during peak load. Before that, Backend Engineer at Timberline Cloud
(2018-2022). Education: M.S. Computer Engineering, Arizona State University,
2017; B.S. Computer Engineering, Cal Poly, 2014. Core skills: GraphQL, Node.js,
REST API design, PostgreSQL, Kafka, TypeScript, Distributed systems, Redis,
AWS, Microservices.
